title: Do not promote a correction episode into a logical rate
statement: For a clean input, independent complete cold meter channels with e_total=.00130805194630 and no other faults, uncorrectable damage modulo a correctable output is bounded by C(48,2)*e_total^2=.001930007881. Adding independent bad-location weights .001 for 72 H gates and .0001 for 48 phase gates gives the pair-union bound .009664890576. Initialization, data idle, thermal input, controller, routing and reset faults remain excluded. Worst-case resources are 48 meters, 72 H gates, 48 phase corrections, nine data qubits and up to 12 dedicated modules/36 modes, with 384/g sensing plus actual other costs. Normal two-round termination uses 24 meters, 36 H and 24 phase corrections. A late fault can leave a correctable output error; a new fault next episode crosses the one-fault boundary. Extended-rectangle and apparatus-memory analysis remains OPEN. No asymptotic logical rate, threshold or same-time storage advantage follows.
